purpose: Preliminary local functionality validation; not a completed dissertation benchmark

memory_measurement.description: Cumulative process peak includes prior sizes and model runs; not an isolated per-size peak.

limitations: Small deterministic 12-SKU subset, five training epochs in comparison, no hyperparameter search.
Historical sales predict observed sales; UCI has no inventory availability or promotion labels.
Scenario and scalability runs use two epochs and one fold to verify execution.
Shared process lifetime peak memory is not an independent per-size or per-model comparison.
Models are research prototypes; production runtime remains baseline/router.
